name: by_feature_code
sql: SELECT string_agg(k||'='||n, ',' ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT feature_code_desc k, count(*) n FROM toronto_centreline GROUP BY 1) s

name: by_jurisdiction
sql: SELECT string_agg(k||'='||n, ',' ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT jurisdiction k, count(*) n FROM toronto_centreline GROUP BY 1) s

name: non_linestring
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM toronto_centreline WHERE GeometryType(geom) <> 'LINESTRING'
